opening.argument: The presentation begins as a lesson about smart contracts. The speaker introduces the session on that subject and explains that the technology works on a blockchain. The supplied narration focuses on how smart contracts operate and their stated benefits. The title and description do invite viewers to join Forsage, with the description claiming it can change their lives. But that promotional language does not specify a payment-for-return promise, request sensitive data, or describe earnings dependent on recruitment. On the evidence supplied, the invitation accompanies a technology explanation; it does not establish a deceptive solicitation.
